messages:
alex: Starting a holdout sweep for new embed model r2. Candidate is `open-embed-2-small-int8`. Running sanity: recall@10 on prod-holdout-20k. Will post numbers when jobs finish.

eval-bot: Eval job queued: job_id=ej-2026-1797, dataset=prod-holdout-20k, seed=42, index=faiss_ivf_flat, nlist=4096

mira: quick reminder — normalize before PQ (we missed L2 norm in the last int8 run, that caused a lot of drift).

alex: Good call. This run used L2 norm + PCA(64) and no OPQ for baseline int8. Using inner-product (MIPS) after normalization.

eval-bot: Run complete. recall@10: baseline open-embed-1 (float32) = 0.872, open-embed-2-small-int8 = 0.803. silhouette(mean) 0.41 -> 0.33. avg cosine sim delta -0.06.

sam: Oof, ~7% abs drop in R@10. Can you share top failure cases? My hunch: paraphrase-heavy queries.

alex: Uploading sketch of failures: `top_failures.csv` (s3://redwood-evals/ej-1797/top_failures.csv). Example pair: Q: "how to reset ssh key" vs Doc: "rotate ssh key on server" -> float32 gives 0.78, int8 gives 0.42.

jin: Did you try PCA=128? Earlier int8 experiments improved when we kept more signal (PCA64 may be too aggressive). Also try OPQ.

alex: Not yet. I'll rerun with PCA=128 + OPQ=true, increase nlist to 8192, same seed=42. Target recall@10 > 0.84. Spawning jobs now.

eval-bot: Job queued: ej-2026-1798 (PCA128 + OPQ + nlist=8192).

eval-bot: Job ej-2026-1798 complete. recall@10 = 0.842; silhouette 0.39. Latency per query +8% (bigger index).

mira: That recovers most of the gap. Can we compare quant backends? per-channel int8 vs uniform quant gave differences previously — try both.

sam: Also run a small dev A/B (5k queries) to check embedding drift vs dev set and to validate reranking effect.

alex: Queued dev A/B (5k) with float32 baseline and PCA128+OPQ int8. Enabled top-k rerank with cross-encoder on top-50 to measure precision lift.

eval-bot: A/B done. P@10 baseline=0.790, int8 (PCA128+OPQ)=0.812 raw, with rerank P@10 -> 0.835. Rerank helps but adds compute and latency.

mira: :thumbsup: Good outcome. Action items: (1) add OPQ+PCA128 recipe to int8 onboarding notebook, (2) run per-channel vs uniform int8 backend comparison and capture quantization distortion metrics, (3) surface top failure examples + cluster visualization to modeling team for potential fine-tune.

alex: I'll patch the onboarding notebook, add a reproducible script (`repro/embed_onboard_int8.sh`) and link the runs. Ping me if you want access to the eval job logs.

sam: Can you also drop the faiss config used into the thread (nlist, nprobe, metric)? helps for run reproducibility.

alex: faiss cfg: index=IVF4096, metric=inner_product (with L2 normalization before store), nprobe=16, OPQ=64->64, PCA_dim=128, pq_bytes=8. Seed=42.

jin: Perfect. Let's keep an eye on cluster silhouette and top-k failure clusters over the next week. If we still see paraphrase failures, we should test targeted fine-tune on paraphrase pairs.

alex: Agreed — logging next steps in the onboarding ticket (#ONBOARD-182).
